agent.problem: No earlier card identifies the tax coin or gives a clue that distinguishes a denarius from a shekel or drachma. A baker using only the earlier cards can choose "denarius" only through prior knowledge or luck, so this blank tests wording they have not seen rather than meaning they can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
